verdict.rationale: Galileo lets users configure background monitoring rules. Alerts on logs fire when a metric, aggregation, threshold and time window are met. Metrics also run continuously over live production traffic, and evals auto-tune from feedback. These are real autonomous background behaviors, but they are a narrow monitor-and-notify form of automation rather than general user-defined automations. missing for 10: general-purpose automation/workflow builder, scheduled or recurring jobs (e.g. scheduled experiments), configurable automated actions beyond alerting, independent or hands-on corroboration.
